about: The same ticket with its text layer, which is where the probe's text-layer parse took the PURCHASE date (01-05-2025) instead of the night: it prints first. Page 1 of the probe's text-layer skeleton: 'Ticket number:' (8), the event line (29) and 'STÅPLASS/STANDING' (38) are REAL; the purchase-date line (5), 'presenterer:' (28), the date, venue and address (30-32) are RECONSTRUCTED from the OCR reading (the purchase date's label is a guess), and the rest are redacted. Pins the date rule: the show date wins over a date on a purchase-labelled line. The venue is not asserted, because where the text layer prints it is reconstructed.

knownFailure.artist: No reading and no rule recovers the artist (probe 2026-09-25): the event line carries the tour name, 'Dumdumboys – XL [romertallførti]', and nothing generic says where the band's name ends. Remove this flag when a rule covers it.
knownFailure.skipsPrompt: A Code 128 is an Admission since #441, so this read is now complete, and it would be added without asking, under the wrong artist (see artist). Asking is the right answer; no rule gets there until one recovers the artist. Remove with the artist's flag.
